layman_headline: Market stuck in fearful sideways churn — holding positions and waiting for a clearer setup.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a 'Fear' mood with Bitcoin hovering around $63,500 and most altcoins treading water or slightly down. Our three open positions (SOL, LINK, FET) are all slightly underwater but well within their stop-loss ranges. None of the new swing trade candidates look attractive right now — the ones that have moved big are overextended, and the rest lack enough data or momentum to justify a new entry.
layman_action: No new trades today. Keep holding the current three positions and monitor their stop-losses. Be patient — fearful markets can produce great entries, but the setup needs to be clearer than what's available now.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates are problematic: BTW (RSI 90, +84% in 7d) and AKE/VELVET (+154%/+103% in 7d) are dangerously extended with extreme correction risk. H just crashed 36% in 24 hours after a 34% weekly gain — classic pump-and-dump pattern. FET is already held. FDUSD is a stablecoin. MON lacks any technical data and is in a steady downtrend (-6.3% weekly, -59% from ATH) with no visible catalyst. LINK already held. BTC dominance at 56.2% continues to suppress alt performance. The Fear & Greed index at 31 is improving from the weekly average of 30.4 but remains firmly in fear territory — not yet at the extreme fear levels (sub-20) that historically produce the best contrarian entries. With 3 positions already open and no clear setup, capital preservation is paramount.

context_banner: Three positions open in a fearful, range-bound market — patience is the highest-conviction trade right now.
